# Example

> The API reference of Example.

Every page below is Markdown. Requests are JSON over HTTP; each operation's page gives its method and URI, its headers, its request and response with an example, its errors and its pagination. Send `Example-Version: v1` on every request you make. `describe.json` holds the whole reference as data (`crucible.describe/1`).

## Overview

- [Service overview](src/index.md): protocol, authentication, service errors, and the operations of each resource

## Operations

- [Ping](src/operations/API_Ping.md): `GET /ping`.

## Data types

- [PingInput](src/shapes/PingInput.md): structure.
- [PingOutput](src/shapes/PingOutput.md): structure.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every page above in one file
- [describe.json](describe.json): the whole reference as JSON (`crucible.describe/1`)
- [changes.json](changes.json): the release chain alone (`crucible.changes/1`)
